Use a hex or RGB style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="#ff9900")`; see the [style documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst). If you meant to request new behavior, discuss it first in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
